findings.claim: The step's objective ("s ošetřeným code: prefixem") is met only by a helper that no production path calls: _strip_code is used nowhere in flexibee.py except its own definition and a unit test, and the simple-form <mena> branch the plan names (mena without showAs, text like "code:CZK") returns "" because _mena never reads the element's .text at all.
findings.fix: Wire _strip_code into the real read path: in _mena, after the showAs and mena/mena/kod branches, fall back to _strip_code(mena_el.text) (and apply _strip_code to the inner kod text), so a simple-form <mena>code:CZK</mena> without showAs yields "CZK" instead of "" — with a test for that shape. Otherwise drop the helper and the claim "hodnoty už bez code: prefixu" from models.py:22.

findings.claim: parse_flexibee catches only ET.ParseError, so the defusedxml guards it advertises (EntitiesForbidden / DTDForbidden / ExternalReferenceForbidden — not ParseError subclasses) escape as raw exceptions instead of FlexibeeFormatError, which the plan maps to a 400; the new test file has no XXE/billion-laughs case, unlike the ISDOC parser tests this module cites as its precedent.
findings.fix: Catch the defusedxml exception family as well (e.g. `except (ET.ParseError, defusedxml.DefusedXmlException) as exc` or a broad ValueError/Exception mapped to FlexibeeFormatError) and add one test asserting an entity-bearing payload raises FlexibeeFormatError, mirroring test_isdoc_parser's XXE case.
